claim_scope: Three independent unit-circle arclength-uniform points; largest original-triangle excircle radius; exact one-dimensional CDF and two conditional marked endpoint limits.
integrity: Classical exradius formulas and the deterministic Erdős lower bound are cited inputs, not claimed discoveries. All proposed distributional and asymptotic conclusions are supported by explicit proofs; no independent validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: Specific to independent boundary-uniform sampling at fixed circumradius.
The exact CDF is an integral, not a claimed elementary antiderivative.
Historical priority remains provisional after bounded available-literature comparisons.
Finite numerical experiments are checks, not infinite or independent proof.
title: Exact maximal-exradius law and dual rare-shape limits for random cyclic triangles
